foundation.name: Desert Peak Plumbing
foundation.overview: Family-owned plumbing, water heater and drain service for the Las Vegas valley.
foundation.mainAddress: 4120 W Sunset Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89118

positioning.pitch: Las Vegas Plumbers You Can Trust Since 1998. We're a family-owned team that treats your home like our own.
positioning.foundingStory: Desert Peak Plumbing was founded in 1998 by Maria Torres, a third-generation plumber who started with one truck and a promise to treat every customer like family. Today our team of 14 licensed technicians serves thousands of homes across the valley.

people.name: Maria Torres
people.title: Owner & Master Plumber
people.description: Maria has 30 years of experience and still answers the phone herself most mornings.

people.name: Devon Reyes
people.title: Service Manager
people.description: Devon dispatches our technicians and makes sure every job finishes on time.

offerings.name: Water Heaters
offerings.description: Whether your tank is leaking or you're ready to go tankless, our technicians install and repair every major brand the same day in most cases.
features: Annual flush and anode rod replacement

offerings.name: Drain Cleaning
offerings.description: Slow drains and backups get cleared fast with professional hydro-jetting and camera inspection so we can show you exactly what's causing the clog.

voiceSamples: That's why we give you a flat-rate price before any work begins, and we never charge for overtime on emergencies.
We're a family-owned team that treats your home like our own.
Slow drains and backups get cleared fast with professional hydro-jetting and camera inspection so we can show you exactly what's causing the clog.
Whether your tank is leaking or you're ready to go tankless, our technicians install and repair every major brand the same day in most cases.
Today our team of 14 licensed technicians serves thousands of homes across the valley.
uniqueSellingPoints: Clean-home promise: boot covers and drop cloths on every job

testimonials.quote: They fixed our water heater the same afternoon and explained everything.
testimonials.author: Jen R., Henderson

faqs.question: Do you charge extra for weekends?
faqs.answer: No. Our flat-rate prices are the same every day of the week, including holidays.

faqs.question: How long does a water heater replacement take?
faqs.answer: Most replacements are finished in two to four hours, and we haul the old tank away for free.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer 0% financing for 12 months on approved credit for installations over $1,000.
